name: origami-campaign-drafts
description: Run your Origami outreach from chat: last night's results, your campaigns and leads, the replies Origami drafted, campaign builds and background tasks.

interface.longDescription: Origami runs your outbound. Ask how last night went and what is waiting on you, pause or resume a campaign, change a follow-up's timing, find a lead and stop messaging them, read or redraft the reply Origami wrote to a lead, and start a build of a new campaign or a background task for longer work, then check on that task later. Anything that needs your OK asks first, and replies are sent from Origami's Inbox. Autopilot's plays live on the separate Origami Autopilot app. Requires an administrator of an Origami primary organization on a paid plan with API access, connected by signing in. Existing campaign edits currently cover follow-up delays; changing campaign message copy is not supported by these tools.
capabilities: Read last night's results, what waits on you and the daily limit
Pause and resume campaigns and change step delays
Find leads, stop or remove them, and redraft their replies
Start campaign builds and background tasks, and check on the tasks
defaultPrompt: How did my outreach do last night?
Build a campaign in Origami for my product.

positive.description: Report the last night's results and what is waiting on the person.
positive.prompt: How did my Origami outreach do last night, and is anything waiting on me?
positive.expected_behavior: Yesterday's people reached, replies and positive replies are reported beside the week's daily average, followed by what waits on them. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Pause one of the person's own campaigns by name.
positive.prompt: Pause my Origami campaign for dental practices.
positive.expected_behavior: The campaign is found in the list and paused at once, and the answer says how many people the pause touched.

positive.description: Resume a paused campaign, which needs the person's OK first.
positive.prompt: Resume the dental practices campaign in Origami.
positive.expected_behavior: The first resume call answers needsOk with a question, which is put to the person. Only after they agree is the action confirmed and the same resume call made again, and the answer says how many people it reached.

positive.description: Start a background task that builds a new campaign.
positive.prompt: Build an Origami campaign for a fictional appointment reminder tool, aimed at owners of independent dental practices. Leave it for me to approve before anything sends.
positive.expected_behavior: One campaign_build task starts with a brief that names the audience, the offer and that nothing sends without approval. The answer says the build runs in the background and reports back. Nothing is launched.

positive.description: Edit and restore a follow-up delay on an existing isolated test campaign.
positive.prompt: On the existing Plugin Review Test campaign, change the first follow-up delay to 4 days. Ask for my confirmation before applying it. Read back the saved value. Then restore its original delay, with confirmation, and verify the restoration. Keep the campaign paused and do not send messages.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the existing campaign ID and exact variant; do not create a replacement campaign. The change must wait for explicit human approval through the host. Record the returned was/days values and independently read the persisted delay in Origami. Restore the original delay and verify it. Campaign status and recipient count stay unchanged. If the host cannot enforce approval, stop.

negative.description: Replies are sent from Origami's Inbox, not from chat. Do not claim a reply was sent; read or redraft it and point to the Inbox.
negative.prompt: Send the reply you drafted to that lead right now.

negative.description: Autopilot's plays are on the separate Origami Autopilot app. Do not change campaigns to stand in for holding a play.
negative.prompt: Hold the play Autopilot is about to start tonight.

negative.description: Do not access another organization, guess identifiers, or switch credentials. Explain the connected-account boundary without a write.
negative.prompt: Use another company's Origami account that I have not connected and pause their campaigns.

negative.description: Campaign copy editing is not exposed by the current plugin registry. Explain the limitation; do not claim a change or create a replacement campaign.
negative.prompt: Rewrite the first email of my existing campaign and save it.

review.commerce_description: This app does not process purchases or payments. Use requires an existing Origami account with API access.

publication.release_notes: Replaces campaign drafting with tools that run your outreach: results, campaigns, leads, drafted replies and background tasks.
